summary: Iteration 4 fix verification of Chef Voice Notes custom player on /menu. All 7 targeted flows PASS. Real 3s WAV plays back: aria-label flips Play→Pause within 1.8s, seek bar aria-valuenow advances (0→48% at t≈1.8s), time counter advances 0:00 → 0:01 / 0:03. Pause holds progress (58% retained). Onended resets to 0:00 and Play. Seek click at 50% jumps currentTime to ~1.5s (aria-valuenow≈56). Carousel with 2 notes shows '1 / 2', Next advances to idx 1 (dot-1 gets w-6 active class, dot-0 loses it), and switching resets player (valuenow=0, aria=Play), then note-2 plays fine. No console errors during play/pause/seek/switch.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceNotesPlayer polls GET /voice-notes every 10s — fine for now but consider websocket/SSE if scaled.

onError handler was not exercised in this run (no bad row available); code review confirms setError(true) is wired to <audio onError>, disables the play button, and renders the 'Audio unavailable' hint via data-testid chef-note-error-<id>. Looks correct.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily POSTed a 2nd voice note (Truffle Burrata) via /api/voice-notes to verify carousel/Next/dots/reset-on-switch. Deleted after verification. DB is back to the single Ember Ribeye 12oz note as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chef Voice Notes player is fully functional end-to-end. If new UI regressions arise, use [data-testid^='chef-note-play-'] to trigger playback and read aria-label + aria-valuenow on [data-testid^='chef-note-seek-'] to verify. Public GET /api/voice-notes returns full audio_base64 (no auth needed).
rca of the issue: Prior iteration 3 failed playback because the seeded audio_base64 was fake bytes (string 'hello' base64), which the browser rejected. Main agent replaced it with a real 3s 44.1kHz PCM WAV; browser now decodes and plays it. No code change was actually required for the fix — only seed data. The onError safety net added in VoiceNotesPlayer.jsx (lines ~16, 40, 49, 52, 134-142, 211-217) is a solid defense for future bad rows.
